mapper.select: SELECT pc.id AS id, pc.product_id AS productId, p.name AS productName, p.main_image AS productImage, p.subtitle AS subtitle, p.price AS price, p.original_price AS originalPrice, p.status AS productStatus, pc.create_time AS collectTime FROM product_collect pc INNER JOIN product p ON pc.product_id = p.id AND p.deleted = 0 WHERE pc.user_id = #{userId} AND pc.deleted = 0 ORDER BY pc.create_time DESC
